definitions.explanation: An individual panel in a manga or a single frame in a film or animation.
A unit of scheduled time, typically referring to a university lecture period or a scheduled slot in a timetable.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧4コマ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This manga has four panels per page.

examples.japanese: 4コマ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短|みじか}くて→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすい。
examples.english: Four-panel manga are short and easy to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つずつ→一つずつ：24348_hitotsuzutsu⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked each frame of the film one by one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3コマ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have three class periods today.

examples.japanese: 1{限目|げんめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コマ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}くて→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: The first-period slot is tough because it's so early in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来学期|らいがっき}→来学期：27523_raigakki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空|あ}きコマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らしたい→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
examples.english: Next semester, I want to reduce my free periods.

notes:
USAGE:
コマ is written in katakana for both senses. The manga/film sense is by far the most common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 4コマ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧ (four-panel manga — a popular format)
- コマ{割|わ}り (panel layout in manga)
- コマ{送|おく}り (frame-by-frame playback)
- {空|あ}きコマ (free period, gap in schedule)

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{駒|こま}→駒：07119_koma⟧ (chess/shogi piece; horse) or ⟦{独楽|こま}→独楽：10104_koma⟧ (spinning top), which are different words with different kanji.
